about: How a fake receiver behaves in each mode, the same for every destination kind. A scenario sets a mode with { "mode": "..." }. 'checksBody': whether a missing required field is refused (with the kind's refusesMissing answer) before the mode applies. 'model': lab (the lab's receivers do this today, backend/src/Api/Receivers.fs) or proposed.

expired-auth.note: The simulator injects this answer today; the receivers have no mode for it yet

lost-record.note: Accepts the request, but a lookup by our lead reference never finds the record (RFC-008 §3.1, accepted-never-verified). In every other mode, a lookup finds what was accepted
